name: kit-test-backlogrun
commands: git config --global user.name kit-test && git config --global user.email kit-test@example.com
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && claude --version
gh issue create --title 'Add a heading to index.html' --body 'Add an h2 under the h1.' --label auto-ok --label run:lane
timeout 60 pnpm josh backlogrun > "$HOME/backlogrun.out" 2>&1; cat "$HOME/backlogrun.out"; grep -q '^backlogrun: started' "$HOME/backlogrun.out"
